lines.speaker: Dockson
lines.text: Sit down, all of you. Nobody's leaving this room until we've decided whether there's still a job.

lines.speaker: Breeze
lines.text: There's no job, Dox. The job was Kelsier. The rest of us were very expensive scenery.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: The skaa in the square didn't run, Breeze. Not at first. They stood there and looked at him. That's new.

lines.speaker: Dockson
lines.text: Sazed's been at the logbook since sunrise. Vin — go and hear him out. Then we talk about what's left.
